## app/src/main/assets/editor/textmate/asm/syntaxes/asm.tmLanguage.json
```json
{
  "information_for_contributors": [
    "This file is a TextMate grammar for x86_64 assembly language"
  ],
  "version": "1.0.2",
  "name": "Assembly",
  "scopeName": "source.asm",
  "patterns": [
    {
      "include": "#comments"
    },
    {
      "include": "#directives"
    },
    {
      "include": "#instructions"
    },
    {
      "include": "#labels"
    },
    {
      "include": "#registers"
    },
    {
      "include": "#numbers"
    },
    {
      "include": "#strings"
    },
    {
      "include": "#preprocessor"
    },
    {
      "include": "#operands"
    },
    {
      "include": "#punctuation"
    }
  ],
  "repository": {
    "comments": {
      "patterns": [
        {
          "begin": ";",
          "beginCaptures": {
            "0": {
              "name": "punctuation.definition.comment.asm"
            }
          },
          "end": "$",
          "name": "comment.line.asm"
        },
        {
          "begin": "/\\*",
          "beginCaptures": {
            "0": {
              "name": "punctuation.definition.comment.begin.asm"
            }
          },
          "end": "\\*/",
          "endCaptures": {
            "0": {
              "name": "punctuation.definition.comment.end.asm"
            }
          },
          "name": "comment.block.asm"
        }
      ]
    },
    "directives": {
      "patterns": [
        {
          "match": "^\\.(text|data|bss|section|global|extern|align|org|equ|=|byte|word|dword|qword|resb|resw|resd|resq|times|incbin|include|if|ifdef|ifndef|else|endif|macro|endmacro|struc|endstruc)\\b",
          "name": "keyword.control.directive.asm"
        },
        {
          "match": "^(section|global|extern|align|org|equ|=|byte|word|dword|qword|resb|resw|resd|resq|times|incbin|include|if|ifdef|ifndef|else|endif|macro|endmacro|struc|endstruc)\\b",
          "name": "keyword.control.directive.nodot.asm"

    "instructions": {

        },
        {
          "match": "\\b(add|adc|sub|sbb|inc|dec|neg|cmp|mul|imul|div|idiv|xadd|xchg|cmpxchg)\\b",
          "name": "keyword.instruction.arithmetic.asm"

        {
          "match": "\\b(and|or|xor|not|test|shl|shr|sal|sar|rol|ror|rcl|rcr|shld|shrd)\\b",
          "name": "keyword.instruction.logical.asm"

        {

          "name": "keyword.instruction.control-flow.asm"

        {
          "match": "\\b(cld|std|cli|sti|clc|stc|cmc|lahf|sahf|pushf|popf|enter|leave|syscall|sysenter|sysexit|sysret|int|into|bound|ud2|hlt|wait|nop|pause|monitor|mwait|xgetbv|xsetbv)\\b",
          "name": "keyword.instruction.processor-control.asm"
        },
        {
          "match": "\\b(lods|lodsb|lodsw|lodsd|lodsq|stos|stosb|stosw|stosd|stosq|movs|movsb|movsw|movsd|movsq|scas|scasb|scasw|scasd|scasq|cmps|cmpsb|cmpsw|cmpsd|cmpsq|ins|insb|insw|insd|insq|outs|outsb|outsw|outsd|outsq|rep|repe|repz|repne|repnz)\\b",
          "name": "keyword.instruction.string.asm"
        },
        {
          "match": "\\b(in|out|rdtsc|cpuid|wrmsr|rdmsr|rdpmc|rdtscp|lfence|mfence|sfence|clflush|clflushopt|clwb|prefetch|prefetchw|prefetchwt1|serialize|tsxldtrk|suspend|resume|umonitor|umwait|tpause|invlpg|invpcid|invd|wbinvd|lock|xacquire|xrelease|xtest)\\b",
          "name": "keyword.instruction.system.asm"
        },
        {
          "match": "\\b(movd|movq|addpd|addps|addsd|addss|subpd|subps|subsd|subss|mulpd|mulps|mulsd|mulss|divpd|divps|divsd|divss|sqrtpd|sqrtps|sqrtsd|sqrtss|maxpd|maxps|maxsd|maxss|minpd|minps|minsd|minss|andpd|andps|andnpd|andnps|orpd|orps|xorpd|xorps|comisd|comiss|ucomisd|ucomiss|cvtsi2sd|cvtsi2ss|cvtsd2si|cvtss2si|cvttsd2si|cvttss2si|paddb|paddw|paddd|paddq|psubb|psubw|psubd|psubq|pmullw|pmulhw|pmulhuw|pmuludq|pand|pandn|por|pxor|psllw|pslld|psllq|psraw|psrad|psrlw|psrld|psrlq|packsswb|packssdw|packuswb|punpckhbw|punpckhwd|punpckhdq|punpcklbw|punpcklwd|punpckldq|pcmpeqb|pcmpeqw|pcmpeqd|pcmpgtb|pcmpgtw|pcmpgtd|shufps|shufpd|unpckhps|unpckhpd|unpcklps|unpcklpd)\\b",
          "name": "keyword.instruction.sse.asm"
        },
        {
          "match": "\\b(vmovd|vmovq|vmovdqu|vmovdqa|vmovups|vmovaps|vaddpd|vaddps|vaddsd|vaddss|vsubpd|vsubps|vsubsd|vsubss|vmulpd|vmulps|vmulsd|vmulss|vdivpd|vdivps|vdivsd|vdivss|vsqrtpd|vsqrtps|vsqrtsd|vsqrtss|vmaxpd|vmaxps|vmaxsd|vmaxss|vminpd|vminps|vminsd|vminss|vandpd|vandps|vandnpd|vandnps|vorpd|vorps|vxorpd|vxorps|vcomisd|vcomiss|vucomisd|vucomiss|vcvtsi2sd|vcvtsi2ss|vcvtsd2si|vcvtss2si|vcvttsd2si|vcvttss2si|vpaddb|vpaddw|vpaddd|vpaddq|vpsubb|vpsubw|vpsubd|vpsubq|vpmullw|vpmulhw|vpmulhuw|vpmuludq|vpand|vpandn|vpor|vpxor|vpsllw|vpslld|vpsllq|vpsraw|vpsrad|vpsrlw|vpsrld|vpsrlq|vpacksswb|vpackssdw|vpackuswb|vpunpckhbw|vpunpckhwd|vpunpckhdq|vpunpcklbw|vpunpcklwd|vpunpckldq|vpcmpeqb|vpcmpeqw|vpcmpeqd|vpcmpgtb|vpcmpgtw|vpcmpgtd|vshufps|vshufpd|vunpckhps|vunpckhpd|vunpcklps|vunpcklpd|vbroadcast|vperm|vperm2|vinsert|vextract|vblend|vpblend|vround|vtest|vptest|vmaskmov|vpmaskmov|vgather|vpgather|vscatter|vpscatter)\\b",
          "name": "keyword.instruction.avx.asm"
        },
        {
          "match": "\\b(aesenc|aesdec|aesenclast|aesdeclast|aesimc|aeskeygenassist|pclmulqdq|sha1msg1|sha1msg2|sha1nexte|sha1rnds4|sha256msg1|sha256msg2|sha256rnds2)\\b",
          "name": "keyword.instruction.crypto.asm"

    "labels": {
      "patterns": [
        {
          "match": "^\\s*([a-zA-Z_$.][a-zA-Z0-9_$.]*):",

            "1": {
              "name": "entity.name.label.asm"

          "name": "meta.label.asm"
        },
        {
          "match": "\\b([a-zA-Z_$.][a-zA-Z0-9_$.]*)\\b",
          "name": "variable.other.label.asm"

    "registers": {
      "patterns": [
        {
          "match": "\\b(rax|eax|ax|al|ah|rbx|ebx|bx|bl|bh|rcx|ecx|cx|cl|ch|rdx|edx|dx|dl|dh|rsi|esi|si|sil|rdi|edi|di|dil|rbp|ebp|bp|bpl|rsp|esp|sp|spl|r8|r8d|r8w|r8b|r9|r9d|r9w|r9b|r10|r10d|r10w|r10b|r11|r11d|r11w|r11b|r12|r12d|r12w|r12b|r13|r13d|r13w|r13b|r14|r14d|r14w|r14b|r15|r15d|r15w|r15b)\\b",
          "name": "support.register.general.asm"

        {
          "match": "\\b(xmm0|xmm1|xmm2|xmm3|xmm4|xmm5|xmm6|xmm7|xmm8|xmm9|xmm10|xmm11|xmm12|xmm13|xmm14|xmm15|ymm0|ymm1|ymm2|ymm3|ymm4|ymm5|ymm6|ymm7|ymm8|ymm9|ymm10|ymm11|ymm12|ymm13|ymm14|ymm15|zmm0|zmm1|zmm2|zmm3|zmm4|zmm5|zmm6|zmm7|zmm8|zmm9|zmm10|zmm11|zmm12|zmm13|zmm14|zmm15)\\b",
          "name": "support.register.vector.asm"
        },
        {
          "match": "\\b(cr0|cr1|cr2|cr3|cr4|cr8|dr0|dr1|dr2|dr3|dr6|dr7|tr3|tr4|tr5|tr6|tr7)\\b",
          "name": "support.register.system.asm"
        },
        {
          "match": "\\b(st\\([0-7]\\)|st[0-7]|mm[0-7])\\b",
          "name": "support.register.other.asm"
        },
        {
          "match": "\\b(r?flags|eflags|r?ip|eip|r?sp|esp|r?bp|ebp)\\b",
          "name": "support.register.special.asm"
        }
      ]
    },
    "numbers": {
      "patterns": [
        {
          "match": "\\b(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|0[0-7]*|[1-9][0-9]*|0b[01]+)\\b",
          "name": "constant.numeric.asm"
        },
        {
          "match": "\\b[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?\\b",
          "name": "constant.numeric.float.asm"
        }
      ]
    },
    "strings": {
      "patterns": [
        {
          "begin": "\"",
          "beginCaptures": {
            "0": {
              "name": "punctuation.definition.string.begin.asm"
            }
          },
          "end": "\"",
          "endCaptures": {
            "0": {
              "name": "punctuation.definition.string.end.asm"
            }
          },
          "name": "string.quoted.double.asm",
          "patterns": [
            {
              "match": "\\\\.",
              "name": "constant.character.escape.asm"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "begin": "'",
          "beginCaptures": {
            "0": {
              "name": "punctuation.definition.string.begin.asm"
            }
          },
          "end": "'",
          "endCaptures": {
            "0": {
              "name": "punctuation.definition.string.end.asm"
            }
          },
          "name": "string.quoted.single.asm",
          "patterns": [
            {
              "match": "\\\\.",
              "name": "constant.character.escape.asm"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "match": "`[^`]*`",
          "name": "string.quoted.backtick.asm"
        }
      ]
    },
    "preprocessor": {
      "patterns": [
        {
          "begin": "^\\s*(%define|%xdefine|%undef|%assign|%defstr|%deftok|%strcat|%strlen|%substr|%macro|%imacro|%endmacro|%rotate|%rep|%endrep|%exitrep|%include|%push|%pop|%repl|%if|%elif|%else|%endif|%ifdef|%ifndef|%ifidn|%ifidni|%ifmacro|%ifnmacro|%ifctx|%ifnctx|%ifempty|%ifnempty|%ifenv|%ifnenv|%error|%warning|%fatal|%line|%arg|%stacksize|%local|%pragma|%clear|comment)\\b",
          "beginCaptures": {
            "1": {
              "name": "keyword.control.preprocessor.asm"
            }
          },
          "end": "$",
          "name": "meta.preprocessor.asm"
        },
        {
          "match": "^\\s*#\\s*(define|undef|if|ifdef|ifndef|else|elif|endif|include|pragma|error|warning|line)\\b",
          "name": "keyword.control.preprocessor.cstyle.asm"
        }
      ]
    },
    "operands": {
      "patterns": [
        {
          "match": "\\[.*?\\]",
          "name": "meta.operand.memory.asm"
        },
        {
          "match": "(byte|word|dword|qword|tword|oword|yword|zword|xword)\\s+(ptr|\\[)",
          "name": "keyword.type.asm"
        },
        {
          "match": "(near|far|short|long|abs|rel)\\s+",
          "name": "keyword.modifier.asm"
        },
        {
          "match": "(offset|seg|ptr|type|size|length)\\b",
          "name": "keyword.operator.asm"
        }
      ]
    },
    "punctuation": {
      "patterns": [
        {
          "match": ",",
          "name": "punctuation.separator.operand.asm"
        },
        {
          "match": "\\$",
          "name": "punctuation.definition.immediate.asm"
        },
        {
          "match": "\\%",
          "name": "punctuation.definition.register.asm"
        },
        {
          "match": "[\\+\\-\\*\\/]",
          "name": "keyword.operator.arithmetic.asm"
        },
        {
          "match": "[\\|\\&\\^\\~]",
          "name": "keyword.operator.bitwise.asm"
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

```json
{
  "information_for_contributors": [
    "This file is a syntax definition for CMake"
  ],
  "name": "CMake",
  "scopeName": "source.cmake",
  "fileTypes": [
    "CMakeLists.txt"
  ],
  "patterns": [
    {
      "include": "#comments"
    },
    {
      "include": "#commands"
    },
    {
      "include": "#variables"
    },
    {
      "include": "#strings"
    },
    {
      "include": "#numbers"
    },
    {
      "include": "#brackets"
    }
  ],
  "repository": {
    "comments": {
      "patterns": [
        {
          "name": "comment.line.number-sign.cmake",
          "begin": "#",
          "end": "$",
          "beginCaptures": {
            "0": {
              "name": "punctuation.definition.comment.cmake"
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    },
    "commands": {
      "patterns": [
        {
          "name": "support.function.cmake",
          "match": "\\b(cmake_minimum_required|project|add_executable|add_library|target_link_libraries|find_package|find_library|find_path|find_program|find_file|include_directories|target_include_directories|add_definitions|target_compile_definitions|target_compile_options|target_compile_features|set|unset|message|if|else|elseif|endif|foreach|endforeach|while|endwhile|function|endfunction|macro|endmacro|return|break|option|configure_file|add_subdirectory|enable_language|enable_testing|add_test|set_target_properties|set_property|get_target_property|get_property|install|export|include|string|list|file|execute_process|add_custom_target|add_custom_command|add_dependencies|target_sources|pkg_check_modules|pkg_search_module)\\b"
        },
        {
          "name": "meta.function.call.cmake",
          "begin": "\\b([a-z][a-z0-9_]*)\\s*\\(",
          "end": "\\)",
          "beginCaptures": {
            "1": {
              "name": "support.function.cmake"
            },
            "0": {
              "name": "punctuation.section.arguments.begin.bracket.round.cmake"
            }
          },
          "endCaptures": {
            "0": {
              "name": "punctuation.section.arguments.end.bracket.round.cmake"
            }
          },
          "patterns": [
            {
              "include": "#variables"
            },
            {
              "include": "#strings"
            },
            {
              "include": "#numbers"
            },
            {
              "include": "#commands"
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    "variables": {
      "patterns": [
        {
          "name": "variable.other.cmake",
          "match": "\\$\\{?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\\}?"
        },
        {
          "name": "constant.language.cmake",
          "match": "\\b(ON|OFF|YES|NO|TRUE|FALSE|CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR|CMAKE_BINARY_DIR|CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR|CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR|CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR|CMAKE_MODULE_PATH|CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH|CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX|CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE|CMAKE_C_COMPILER|CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER|CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME|UNIX|WIN32|APPLE|CMAKE_C_STANDARD|CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD|BUILD_SHARED_LIBS|CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE)\\b"
        }
      ]
    },
    "strings": {
      "patterns": [
        {
          "name": "string.quoted.double.cmake",
          "begin": "\"",
          "end": "\"",
          "beginCaptures": {
            "0": {
              "name": "punctuation.definition.string.begin.cmake"
            }
          },
          "endCaptures": {
            "0": {
              "name": "punctuation.definition.string.end.cmake"
            }
          },
          "patterns": [
            {
              "include": "#variables"
            },
            {
              "include": "#string_escaped_char"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "name": "string.unquoted.cmake",
          "match": "[^\\s\\\"\\#\\$\\(\\)]+",
          "patterns": [
            {
              "include": "#variables"
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    "string_escaped_char": {
      "patterns": [
        {
          "match": "\\\\.",
          "name": "constant.character.escape.cmake"
        }
      ]
    },
    "numbers": {
      "match": "\\b[0-9]+\\b",
      "name": "constant.numeric.cmake"
    },
    "brackets": {
      "patterns": [
        {
          "match": "\\(",
          "name": "punctuation.section.parens.begin.bracket.round.cmake"
        },
        {
          "match": "\\)",
          "name": "punctuation.section.parens.end.bracket.round.cmake"
        },
        {
          "match": "\\[\\=",
          "name": "punctuation.section.bracket.begin.cmake"
        },
        {
          "match": "=\\]",
          "name": "punctuation.section.bracket.end.cmake"
        }
      ]
    },
    "operators": {
      "patterns": [
        {
          "match": "STREQUAL|EQUAL|MATCHES|VERSION_LESS|VERSION_GREATER|VERSION_EQUAL|VERSION_LESS_EQUAL|VERSION_GREATER_EQUAL|LESS|GREATER|EXISTS|IS_DIRECTORY|IS_SYMLINK|IS_ABSOLUTE|DEFINED|IN_LIST|NOT|AND|OR",
          "name": "keyword.operator.logical.cmake"
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

```json
{
  "name": "Coq",
  "scopeName": "source.coq",
  "fileTypes": [
    "v",
    "coq"
  ],
  "patterns": [
    {
      "name": "comment.line.double-dash.coq",
      "match": "\\(\\*.*?\\*\\)",
      "comment": "Coq comments"
    },
    {
      "name": "keyword.control.coq",
      "match": "\\b(Theorem|Lemma|Proof|Qed|Definition|Fixpoint|CoFixpoint|Axiom|Inductive|CoInductive|Record|Structure|Module|End|Section|Import|Require|Export|Print|Eval|Check|Goal|Existing|Universe|Type|Set|Prop)\\b",
      "comment": "Coq keywords"
    },
    {
      "name": "keyword.operator.coq",
      "match": "\\b(forall|exists|match|with|end|if|then|else|let|in|fun|fix|cofix|return|:=|=>|->|\\.|:|,|;|@|\\||\\+|-|\\*|/|=|<>|<|<=|>|>=|\\{|\\}|\\(|\\)|\\[|\\])\\b",
      "comment": "Coq operators and punctuation"
    },
    {
      "name": "keyword.other.coq",
      "match": "\\b(as|at|by|coercion|else|end|exists|exists2|fix|for|forall|fun|if|IF|in|let|match|measure|module|Parameter|pattern|return|struct|then|using|where|with|beta|delta|iota|zeta)\\b",
      "comment": "Additional Coq keywords"
    },
    {
      "name": "constant.language.coq",
      "match": "\\b(True|False|nil|cons|O|S)\\b",
      "comment": "Coq built-in constants"
    },
    {
      "name": "variable.other.coq",
      "match": "\\b[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9_']*\\b",
      "comment": "Coq variables"
    },
    {
      "name": "entity.name.type.coq",
      "match": "\\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_']*\\b",
      "comment": "Coq type names"
    },
    {
      "name": "string.quoted.double.coq",
      "begin": "\"",
      "end": "\"",
      "patterns": [
        {
          "name": "constant.character.escape.coq",
          "match": "\\\\."
        }
      ],
      "comment": "Coq strings"
    },
    {
      "name": "constant.numeric.coq",
      "match": "\\b[0-9]+\\b",
      "comment": "Coq numbers"
    },
    {
      "name": "keyword.control.tactics.coq",
      "match": "\\b(apply|assumption|auto|case|clear|clearbody|cofix|compute|constructor|cut|destruct|discriminate|double|elim|exact|exists|field|firstorder|fold|generalize|hnf|idtac|induction|injection|intros|inversion|left|move|omega|red|refine|reflexivity|rewrite|right|ring|simpl|split|subst|symmetry|transitivity|trivial|unfold)\\b",
      "comment": "Coq tactics"
    }
  ],
  "repository": {
    "block_comment": {
      "name": "comment.block.coq",
      "begin": "\\(\\*",
      "end": "\\*\\)",
      "patterns": [
        {
          "include": "#block_comment"
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```
